sloka: इयं मधुपुरी रस्या मधुरा देवनिर्मिता ।निवेशं प्राप्नुयाच्छीघ्रमेष मे ऽस्तु वरः परः ।। ७.७०.५ ॥
transliteration: iyaṁ madhupurī rasyā madhurā devanirmitā ।niveśaṁ prāpnuyācchīghrameṣa me 'stu varaḥ paraḥ ।। 7.70.5 ॥

translations.english: Shatrughna requested that this delightful and sweet city of Madhu, which was created by the gods, quickly become a populated settlement, declaring this to be his foremost boon.
